verdict.rationale: Ashby has a documented REST API, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found all common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. The llms.txt index and markdown versions of doc pages are machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
